name: marketnow
description: MarketNow — The open marketplace for MCP-compatible agent skills. Search, discover, and install 5,054+ verified MCP skills with transparent one-time pricing (from $0.99). Designed for autonomous agent consumption.

transport.note: Currently stdio only. HTTP transport (SSE/WebSocket) is on the roadmap.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search skills by query, category, or max price

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get full details of a specific skill by ID or slug

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: Get marketplace metadata (8535 skills, pricing tiers, commission)

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get the npx install command for a skill

verification.sentinel_l1: Automated static analysis on every submission (repo exists, README, package manifest, license, no hardcoded secrets, no malicious patterns)
verification.human_review: Manual review by MarketNow team before listing (24-48h)

listings.note: Listed but data is outdated (shows 13,859 skills, mentions crypto payments that don't exist). Contact mcp.so to update.
